description: Look up patient-friendly health information for a SNOMED CT clinical concept via the NLM MedlinePlus Connect service. Returns MedlinePlus topic titles, URLs, and plain-language summaries for conditions matching the concept (e.g. 44054006 → Diabetes mellitus type 2, 22298006 → Myocardial infarction, 195967001 → Asthma). Provide the optional display_name to improve match accuracy. Supports English and Spanish responses (language=es). Source: US NLM MedlinePlus Connect — public domain, no auth, unlimited free.

code.description: SNOMED CT concept ID to look up (e.g. 44054006 for Diabetes mellitus type 2, 22298006 for Myocardial infarction).

display_name.description: Human-readable SNOMED concept name (optional, improves matching). Example: "Diabetes mellitus".

language.description: Response language: en (English) or es (Spanish). Default: en.

name: medlineplus.clinical.snomed_lookup

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: MedlinePlus Connect — SNOMED CT Lookup
